description_en: Retrieves the details of a single MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) migration plan
description_zh: 获取单个MMA迁移计划详情
name: GetMmsJob

config.description_en: The configuration of the migration job

enableVerification.description_en: Enables data verification. The current verification method is to execute a SELECT COUNT statement on the source and destination to compare the row counts
enableVerification.description_zh: 开启校验，目前校验方式是在源和目标端执行select count，对比行数

increment.description_en: Incremental migration. Only new or modified partitions are migrated. Note: Modified partitions are re-migrated
increment.description_zh: 增量迁移：只迁移新分区或有变动的分区，注意有变动的分区会被重迁

additionalProperties.description_en:
The partition filter expression. Example: p1 >= '2022-03-04' and (p2 = 10 or p3 > 20) and p4 in ('abc', 'cde'). The following items describe the expression:

p1, p2, and p3 are partition names.

Partition values can be strings or numbers. Strings must be enclosed in double or single quotation marks.

For partition key columns of data types other than INT and BIGINT, the partition values can only be strings.

The following comparison operators are supported: >, >=, =, <, <=, and <>.

The IN operator is supported in partition filter expressions.

The following logical operators are supported: AND and OR.

Parentheses are supported
additionalProperties.description_zh:
分区过滤表达式。例如：p1 >= '2022-03-04' and (p2 = 10 or p3 > 20) and p4 in ('abc', 'cde')，介绍如下：

p1、p2 和 p3 均为分区名。

分区值仅包含字符串和数字，字符串被双引号或单引号包裹。

除 INT 和 BIGINT 类型的分区列值外，其他类型的分区值都只能取字符串值。

比较操作符包括：>、>=、= 、<、<=、<>。

分区过滤表达式支持 IN 操作符。

逻辑操作符包括：AND 和 OR。

支持使用括号

partitionFilters.description_en: The partition filter expression. This parameter specifies the partition filter expression for a specific table
partitionFilters.description_zh: 分区过滤表达式。 配置指定"表"对应的"分区过滤表达式"

partitions.description_en: If type is set to Partitions, this parameter specifies the list of partition IDs of the table to migrate
partitions.description_zh: 当 type=Partitions 时, 通过该参数指定要迁移表的分区 ID 列表

items.description_en: The partition ID of the table to migrate

tableBlackList.description_en: If type is set to Database, this parameter specifies the tables to exclude from the migration
tableBlackList.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 通过 tableBlackList 指定排除哪些表不迁移

items.description_en: If type is set to Database, this parameter specifies the table to exclude
items.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 要排查的表

additionalProperties.description_en: The mapping from source table names to destination table names
additionalProperties.description_zh: 源表名->目标名 映射

tableMapping.description_en: The mapping from source table names to destination table names
tableMapping.description_zh: 源表名->目标名 映射

tableWhiteList.description_en: If type is set to Database, this parameter specifies the list of tables to migrate. If you do not specify this parameter, all tables in the database are migrated
tableWhiteList.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 指定的要迁移的表列表。如果没有指定 tableWhiteList，则迁移对应 Database 下的所有表

items.description_en: If type is set to Database, this parameter specifies the table to migrate
items.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 指定的要迁移的表

tables.description_en: If type is set to Tables, this parameter specifies the list of names of the tables to migrate
tables.description_zh: 当 type=Tables 时, 通过该参数指定要迁移的表的名称列表

items.description_en: The name of the table to migrate

taskType.description_en: Deprecated. Valid values: MOCK, HIVE (a Hive user-defined table-valued function (UDTF) task), HIVE_DATAX (a Hive DataX task), COPY_TASK (an ODPS Copy Task), ODPS_INSERT_OVERWRITE (an ODPS simple insert overwrite task), MC2MC_VERIFY, OSS, HIVE_OSS, HIVE_SPARK, and BIGQUERY
taskType.description_zh: Depcreated； 可以指定的值有 MOCK, HIVE: hive udtf task, HIVE_DATAX: hive datax task, COPY_TASK: odps Copy Task, ODPS_INSERT_OVERWRITE: odps simple insert overwrite task, MC2MC_VERIFY, OSS, HIVE_OSS, HIVE_SPARK, BIGQUERY
taskType.title_en: MOCK, HIVE: hive udtf task, HIVE_DATAX: hive datax task, COPY_TASK: odps Copy Task, ODPS_INSERT_OVERWRITE: odps simple insert overwrite task, MC2MC_VERIFY, OSS, HIVE_OSS, HIVE_SPARK, BIGQUERY
taskType.title_zh: MOCK, HIVE: hive udtf task, HIVE_DATAX: hive datax task, COPY_TASK: odps Copy Task, ODPS_INSERT_OVERWRITE: odps simple insert overwrite task, MC2MC_VERIFY, OSS, HIVE_OSS, HIVE_SPARK, BIGQUERY

createTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

eta.description_en: The expected completion time of the migration. Note: A smaller eta value indicates a higher priority for the migration task
eta.description_zh: 期望的迁移完成时间. 注意：eta值越小，迁移任务的优先级会越高

name.description_en: The name of the migration job

sourceName.description_en: The name of the data source

srcDbName.description_en: The name of the source database

srcSchemaName.description_en: The name of the source schema. This parameter specifies the schema in a Layer 3 namespace
srcSchemaName.description_zh: 源schema name-三层命名空间中的schema

status.description_en: The status of the migration task

taskDone.description_en: The number of completed migration tasks

taskNum.description_en: The number of migration tasks included in the job

type.description_en: The migration scope. Valid values: Database, Tables, and Partitions
